item.title: Carjacking suspect crashes after taking delivery driver's vehicle in downtown Austin
item.description: A delivery driver is recovering after being carjacked during a stop at an apartment on West Seventh Street, according to the Austin Police Department.

item.title: Denton Ryan drops Leander Glenn to repeat as UIL girls 5A Division I hoops champs
item.description: Ryan outrebounded Glenn 40-29 overall, including 22-7 on the offensive end, gaining extra possessions and keeping the ball away from the Grizzlies. Ryan put up 57 shots to Glenn's 35 attempts, and the Raiders made four more buckets than the Grizzlies, 15-11.

item.title: 'Austin has lost a light': Mourners pack church for mass shooting victim's funeral
item.description: Around 1,000 people packed LifeFamily Church in southwest Austin on Friday, according to one estimate, to say goodbye to 19-year-old Ryder Harrington, one of three people killed in Sunday’s mass shooting that is being investigated as a potential act of terrorism.

item.title: Westlake's undefeated run ends in girls 6A Division II title game
item.description: The Tigers avenged a double overtime loss to the Chaparrals on Nov. 15 with a stout defensive effort. Westlake shot 35% from the field, 16-for-46, but struggled from 3-point range. The Chaps were 3-for-18 from long distance.

item.title: Booker's career-high 31 points fuels Texas to SEC semifinal win over Ole Miss
item.description: Booker scored 13 of her career-high 31 points in the frame, helping the third-seeded Longhorns hold off the pesky Rebels 85-68 in the Southeastern Conference women's basketball tournament semifinals Saturday in Greenville, South Carolina.

item.title: Digital evidence, Uber records tie 'former friend' to July 2024 killing in Austin
item.description: Digital evidence collected for a July 2024 murder investigation led to the arrest of 26-year-old Chance Barrett.

item.title: Central Texas events postponed March 7, 8 due to potential thunderstorms
item.description: As the potential for thunderstorms rises as the weekend approaches, several events across Central Texas have been cancelled.

item.title: Lime is teaching people how to safely ride e-scooters, e-bikes ahead of SXSW
item.description: Lime and the Downtown Austin Alliance partnered to launch a free training and safety campaign at Republic Park the first week of each month. The first installation of the First Ride Academy (FRA) program was on Saturday at Republic Park.

item.title: Community honors Sixth Street shooting victims with memorial outside Buford’s
item.description: A memorial continues to grow outside of Buford's as the community remembers those loss in the deadly mass shooting.

item.title: Scattered showers and storm through the evening
item.description: Scattered showers and thunderstorms will continue through the evening hours. -- Meteorologist Tommy House
